description: ENTERPRISE COMMAND PATTERN IMPLEMENTATION: Complete Command Pattern architecture implementation for NVDA staging macro automation with enterprise-grade security, monitoring, and resilience. Implemented comprehensive command-based macro automation system with abstract command classes, priority queue management, circuit breaker protection, and distributed tracing. Added FetchExpirationsCommand, GetStockDataCommand, GenerateAITakeawaysCommand, and GenerateAIOptionsCommand with full error handling and retry logic. Enterprise features include security context integration, audit trails, performance monitoring, memory management, and React hooks for seamless UI integration. Command queue supports dependency resolution, priority scheduling, pause/resume/cancel operations, and real-time progress tracking. Complete isolation from production systems with comprehensive enterprise monitoring and compliance framework.
